title: Walls and Gates
description:
You are given an `m x n` grid `rooms` initialized with three possible values:
- `-1`: A wall or an obstacle.
- `0`: A gate.
- `INF`: (represented as `2147483647`) An empty room.

Fill each empty room with the distance to its nearest gate. If it is impossible to reach a gate, it should remain `INF`.

examples.explanation: Shortest distances computed from each gate (0).

hints: Instead of starting BFS from each empty room, start a multi-source BFS simultaneously from all gates (0).
The first time you reach an empty room via BFS, you have found its shortest distance to any gate.
Update the room distance to rooms[r][c] + 1 and push into queue.
